name: Bodatsu ~Kindan no Shokushu Soukan~
source:
Main character wakes up with tentacles growing from his body. Mother screams in horror upon entering the room. This situation leads to forbidden incest relations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公醒来后，发现身体长出了触手。母亲走进房间，看见这一幕惊恐尖叫。这个状况最终让母子之间发展出禁忌乱伦关系。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vndb-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
